content:
Overview

Hua Hin is a city in Prachuap Khiri Khan with a population of 100,000. A royal beach resort town with a relaxed atmosphere, golf courses, and a growing expat community, offering a quieter alternative to Pattaya and Phuket. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year.
